principles: Use theorem-library lemmas before expanding definitions.
Prefer narrow simplification sets over unrestricted simp.
Run low-cost deterministic tactics before broad proof search.
Use domain-specific tactics only when the goal shape justifies them.
Promote a strategy only from repeated, kernel-checked, provenance-complete measurements.

controlled_search: aesop with explicit rule sets and bounded configuration

avoid_by_default: unrestricted simp at the beginning of every goal
unrestricted aesop before simplifying or decomposing the goal
unfolding every definition when a library lemma can close the goal
nlinarith before checking whether positivity or linarith suffices
treating successful helper lemmas as proof of an unfinished top-level theorem
promotion_gates: repeated benchmark shows no regression in reliability
performance gain measured rather than inferred from shorter source
notes: Recent public announcements are leads, not equivalent evidence levels.
FLT formalization is a verification-scale case study, not a newly discovered proof of Fermat's Last Theorem.
ETH and analytic-number-theory claims must retain their announced/review status until artifacts and exact statements are independently checked.
No tactic profile is optimized until comparative benchmarks exist.
